policy.license_policy: External skills remain upstream-owned. Install on demand, keep copies ignored, and inspect the upstream license before redistributing or copying source into this repository.
policy.selection_rule: Install the smallest set that covers the task. Prefer core and recommended entries over optional or reference-only entries.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.notes: General image generation/editing backend. Prefer a host-provided image generation tool when available; the skill also documents a CLI fallback.

skills.name: sprite-pipeline
skills.notes: Whole-strip generation, frame normalization, shared anchors, scale consistency and preview-sheet QA.

skills.name: hatch-pet
skills.notes: Codex-pet-oriented atlas construction and QA. Use its consistency rules even when adapting to another pet runtime.

skills.name: ai-image-generation
skills.notes: Multi-model image router for GPT Image, FLUX, Gemini, Seedream and other providers through inference.sh.

skills.name: ai-video-generation
skills.notes: Multi-model video router. Useful when the desired model/provider is not fixed in advance.

skills.name: character-design-sheet
skills.notes: Turnarounds, expression sheets, palettes and character consistency techniques.

skills.name: storyboard-creation
skills.notes: Shot vocabulary, continuity, camera rules, panel planning and animatic preparation.

skills.name: comfyui-api
skills.notes: Queues workflows through the ComfyUI REST API, validates availability and retrieves outputs.

skills.name: comfyui-workflow-builder
skills.notes: Builds executable ComfyUI workflow JSON from natural-language production requirements.

skills.name: comfyui-prompt-engineer
skills.notes: Model-specific prompting rather than one generic prompt dialect for every checkpoint.

skills.name: comfyui-video-pipeline
skills.notes: Local video generation routing. Treat hardware/model requirements as dynamic and verify local inventory before execution.

skills.name: higgsfield-generate
skills.notes: Broad image/video/3D/audio generation and reference-aware workflows. Requires Higgsfield CLI/auth.

skills.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
skills.notes: Studio, lifestyle, person-with-product, virtual try-on, hero/banner, carousel and conceptual product modes.

skills.name: higgsfield-game-generation
skills.notes: Can operate in assets-only mode for sprites, tileable textures, animated 3D assets, music, SFX and voice.

skills.name: ip-studio
skills.notes: Locks a reusable 2D character identity and derives static/dynamic states without letting derivatives redefine the master identity.

skills.name: 2dimg2motion
skills.notes: Reference-image-to-animation-frame workflow with identity locking and sprite-sheet output.

skills.name: h3-prompt-writing
skills.notes: Portable MiniMax H3 prompting skill. Unlike the Hub-canvas production skills, this one is explicitly usable by generic agent harnesses.

skills.name: faceless-explainer
skills.notes: Deterministic HTML/GSAP explainer-video production from text; useful when generated video is not the right tool for every shot.

skills.name: img2threejs
skills.notes: Reference-image to animation-ready procedural Three.js model with staged visual correction.

skills.name: threejs-3d-generator
skills.notes: Tripo-backed GLB/FBX generation, texturing, rigging, retargeting and game-ready conversion.

skills.name: design-dna
skills.notes: Extracts measurable design tokens, qualitative visual language and effects into a structured profile. Use as analysis, not as permission to copy identity.

skills.name: photoreal
skills.notes: Prompt layer for less synthetic-looking photographic human imagery. Pair with an actual image backend.

skills.name: oil-icon
skills.notes: Generates a coherent sheet first, then slices/background-removes it so an icon set shares one visual language.

skills.name: ads-photoshoot
skills.notes: Product-fidelity-heavy alternative for paid-ad photoshoot variants with provenance and review gates.

skills.name: director-skills
skills.notes: Modular filmmaking router covering story, screenplay scenes, shot lists, visual bibles, continuity and model-specific prompt packaging.

skills.name: 3d-animation-short-generator
skills.notes: Excellent workflow reference, but its execution path depends on MiniMax Hub canvas tools. Do not present it as a generic drop-in runtime skill.

skills.name: workrally
skills.notes: Broad AIGC production-management CLI and useful reference for project/series/shot/asset schemas. Platform-specific, so keep outside the default install set.
